issue-whole:
-f query=query($owner:String!,$repo:String!,$number:Int!){repository(owner:$owner,name:$repo){issue(number:$number){number url title body state updatedAt authorAssociation author{login} editor{login} labels(first:100){nodes{name}} timelineItems(last:1,itemTypes:[RENAMED_TITLE_EVENT]){nodes{... on RenamedTitleEvent{actor{login}}}} comments(last:100){nodes{id url body authorAssociation author{login} editor{login}}}}}} --jq=def standing: . == "OWNER" or . == "MEMBER" or . == "COLLABORATOR"; .data.repository.issue | (.author.login // "ghost") as $author | {number, url, title, body: ((.body // "") | gsub("
"; "
") | sub("\s*<!-- card [^>]* -->\s*$"; "")), closed: (.state == "CLOSED"), labels: [.labels.nodes[].name], stamp: .updatedAt, author: $author, trusted: ((.authorAssociation | standing) or (((.editor.login // $author) != $author) and ((.timelineItems.nodes[0].actor.login // $author) != $author))), said: [.comments.nodes[] | (.author.login // "ghost") as $by | ((.authorAssociation | standing) or ((.editor.login // $by) != $by)) as $known | {id, by: $by, who: (if $known then $by else $by + ", who has no standing in the repository," end), trusted: $known, body: (.body | gsub("
"; "
")), url, ours: (.body | contains("<!-- said "))}]}
pulls-listed: --state=open --limit=50 --json=number,title,author,headRefName,isDraft,reviewDecision,statusCheckRollup,url,updatedAt --jq=[.[] | {number, title, by: (.author.login // ""), branch: .headRefName, draft: .isDraft, review: ((.reviewDecision // "") | ascii_downcase | gsub("_"; " ")), checks: ([.statusCheckRollup[]? | (if (.conclusion // "") != "" then .conclusion else (.state // .status // "pending") end) | ascii_downcase] | group_by(.) | map("\(length) \(.[0])") | join(", ")), url, updated: .updatedAt}]
runs-listed: --limit=30 --json=workflowName,displayTitle,headBranch,status,conclusion,url,createdAt --jq=[.[] | {name: .workflowName, title: .displayTitle, branch: .headBranch, state: (if .status == "completed" then .conclusion else .status end), url, at: .createdAt}]
work-of: --state=all --limit=1 --json=number,url,state,updatedAt,reviewDecision,statusCheckRollup,commits,closingIssuesReferences --jq=if length == 0 then {found: false} else .[0] | {found: true, url, state: (.state | ascii_downcase), changed: .updatedAt, reviews: ((.reviewDecision // "") | ascii_downcase | gsub("_"; " ")), checks: ([.statusCheckRollup[]? | (if (.conclusion // "") != "" then .conclusion else (.state // .status // "pending") end) | ascii_downcase] | group_by(.) | map("\(length) \(.[0])") | join(", ")), commits: (.commits | length), commit: ((.commits | last | .oid) // ""), committed: ((.commits | last | .committedDate) // ""), issues: [.closingIssuesReferences[]?.url]} end
